chapter: Jump for Joy, records and royalties
title: Freezing at a Benny Goodman recording date
summary: Goodman promised to record him at Cafe Society time, but Turner was too scared to sing a note.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Or you... You must have sung with them at some point, though.
Oh, yeah, I used to sing with them years ago. I was going to make a record with Benny Goodman but I was so scared I couldn't get the words together.
Was that back in New York when you were...
When you were at Cafe Society?
When I was at Cafe Society. I went to the studio and ever'thing. Benny Goodman had promised me he was gonna record me, an' he did, and I ain't sung the first number.
I was so excited. That was the biggest blow-up I ever done in my life.
That the only time that ever happened?
That's the only time that ever happened to me. I was scared to death.
